F-correlation (kernel canonical correlation) between two variables

Source: R/f_correlation.r
f_correlation.Rd

Bach & Jordan (2002) kernel canonical correlation, as used by BottomUpParceLiNGAM's independence = "fcorr" option. Returns a value in (roughly) [0, 1]; larger means more dependent.

Usage

f_correlation(x, y)

Arguments

x

numeric vector

y

numeric vector (same length as x)

Value

F-correlation value (scalar)

Details

A constant x or y (zero variance) carries no dependence information and is treated as trivially independent (returns 0) rather than propagating a division-by-zero standardization into NaN/Inf.
